clues: This is a small town in the south east of Brazil, in a large state. It sits far from Cuiaba, the main city of that state.
Rain falls most in December, while June to August stay dry each year. Most days feel warm, but heat and frost have both been felt here.
This place split off to stand on its own in 1953. Before that it was just a small part of a different town.
Gem hunters first came here long ago, hunting bright stones in the wild ground. Folks still dig for diamonds in that same ground today.
Pop singer Vanessa da Mata was born here in 1976. She is now known all over the world.
